title: German Seafood Fideua with Spanish Flair
description: A hearty German dish with a Spanish twist, featuring seafood and fideua. Perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Velvety besciamella sauce
ingredients.notes: Creamy sauce made from butter, flour, and milk

ingredients.name: White wine
ingredients.notes: Dry white wine for added flavor

instructions: Cook the fideua according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat the Spanish olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the seafood mix to the skillet and cook until the seafood is pink and cooked through.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid has almost completely reduced.
Stir in the velvety besciamella sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cooked fideua to the skillet and toss with the seafood mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
Optional: Add a squeeze of lemon juice for extra brightness.
